Prasad N vs District Collector on 7 January, 2025

This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On
07.01.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:

The grievance of the petitioner is that an application under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been rejected on the ground of delay.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: There is a delay of 109 days in preferring the application.
Power is available to condone the delay up to one year.
In the above circumstances, this writ petition is allowed.

The 2 nd respondent shall reconsider the application with notice to the petitioner and pass fresh orders within one month from WP(C) NO. 44561 OF 2024 2025:KER:469 the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
The petitioner shall be permitted to file additional affidavit in support of the reasons for the delay.

Sd/-
